{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure clean state
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Now check for the 6 QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders found: {len(qa_orders)}")
print(qa_orders[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'customer_age', 'status', 'revenue']])"}
